Mike Braun was never a member of the Democrat Party, as previously represented in the page. In the state of Indiana, voters are not required to register with a certain party and can pull ballots from either party during primaries. Braun maintains he has been a lifelong Republican but pulled Democratic primary ballots in select elections to weigh in on contested local races where no Republicans were running, a common practice in his home area of the historically Democratic Southwestern Indiana.
